shortDescription: Manages threat-profile objects on Check Point over Web Services API

options.name: activate_protections_by_extended_attributes
options.description: Activate protections by these extended attributes.

options.name: active_protections_performance_impact
options.description: Protections with this performance impact only will be activated in the profile.

options.name: active_protections_severity
options.description: Protections with this severity only will be activated in the profile.

options.name: advanced_dns_settings
options.description: Advanced DNS Settings.

options.name: anti_bot
options.description: Is Anti-Bot blade activated.

options.name: anti_virus
options.description: Is Anti-Virus blade activated.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: color
options.description: Color of the object. Should be one of existing colors.

options.name: comments
options.description: Comments string.

options.name: confidence_level_high
options.description: Action for protections with high confidence level.

options.name: confidence_level_low
options.description: Action for protections with low confidence level.

options.name: confidence_level_medium
options.description: Action for protections with medium confidence level.

options.name: deactivate_protections_by_extended_attributes
options.description: Deactivate protections by these extended attributes.

options.name: details_level
options.description: The level of detail for some of the fields in the response can vary from showing only the UID value of the object to a fully detailed representation of the object.

options.name: ignore_errors
options.description: Apply changes ignoring errors. You won't be able to publish such a changes. If ignore-warnings flag was omitted - warnings will also be ignored.

options.name: ignore_warnings
options.description: Apply changes ignoring warnings.

options.name: indicator_overrides
options.description: Indicators whose action will be overridden in this profile.

options.name: ips
options.description: Is IPS blade activated.

options.name: ips_settings
options.description: IPS blade settings.

options.name: malicious_mail_policy_settings
options.description: Malicious Mail Policy for MTA Gateways. Available from R80.20.M1 management version.

options.name: name
options.description: Object name.

options.name: overrides
options.description: Overrides per profile for this protection.

options.name: scan_malicious_links
options.description: Scans malicious links (URLs) inside email messages.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the access rule (present or absent).

options.name: tags
options.description: Collection of tag identifiers.

options.name: threat_emulation
options.description: Is Threat Emulation blade activated.

options.name: threat_extraction
options.description: Is Threat Extraction blade activated.

options.name: use_extended_attributes
options.description: Whether to activate/deactivate IPS protections according to the extended attributes.

options.name: use_indicators
options.description: Indicates whether the profile should make use of indicators.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.

options.name: zero_phishing
options.description: Is Zero Phishing blade activated.
